text: The analytics database vacuum should run every night at 02:10 UTC, after the import finishes.
Recorded: schedule the analytics vacuum for 02:10 UTC each night, after imports.
We moved the analytics import to 01:50 UTC so the 02:10 vacuum still has a 20 minute gap.
The nightly archive is uploaded to object storage bucket cedar-archive-prod.
Keep those archive objects for 45 days, then expire them.
The archive target is cedar-archive-prod with a 45 day retention window.
For the lemon loaf, preheat the oven to 190 degrees Celsius and bake for 42 minutes.
Lemon loaf: 190°C oven, 42 minutes.
If the top browns early, cover it with foil for the final ten minutes.
Set the travel laptop's maximum battery charge to 80 percent to reduce wear.
The travel laptop charge cap is 80%.
The office laptop can stay at the default full charge; this limit is only for travel.

Staging runs in eu-west-1.
Maybe staging should use us-east-1 to match production.
Please avoid scheduling design reviews on Mondays; Tuesday or Thursday afternoons work best.
Design reviews should be on Tuesday or Thursday afternoon, never Monday.
For the weekly one-on-one, Friday morning is fine.

Renew the passport in summer 2027, ahead of its November expiry.

Mina owns rollback, and the backup must finish before the release window opens.

The return train on Sunday is a separate booking and leaves at 17:15.

Checkout alert threshold: over 2% errors for 5 minutes.
The latency warning is different: p95 above 800 milliseconds for ten minutes.

Please skip books centered on military battles.
